questions.question: With a key of one can picture for 10 cans, how would you show 45 cans in a pictograph?
questions.expected_answer: Draw 4 whole pictures for 40 cans and half a picture for the other 5 cans.

questions.question: Name three things every bar graph needs.
questions.expected_answer: A title, labels on both axes, and a scale that starts at 0 and goes up in equal steps.

questions.question: In April, Grade 6A collected 35 cans and Grade 6B collected 50. What does the double bar graph show?
questions.expected_answer: The 6B bar is taller than the 6A bar. Grade 6B collected 15 more cans than Grade 6A in April.
